WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) as overall_avg_price FROM InvoiceLine
),
invoice_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    i.InvoiceId,
    c.Country,
    AVG(il.UnitPrice) as invoice_avg_price
  FROM Invoice i
  JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId
  JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
  GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country
),
invoice_deviations AS (
  SELECT 
    is.InvoiceId,
    is.Country,
    is.invoice_avg_price,
    oa.overall_avg_price,
    is.invoice_avg_price - oa.overall_avg_price as deviation
  FROM invoice_stats is
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
),
country_avg_deviations AS (
  SELECT 
    Country,
    AVG(deviation) as country_avg_deviation
  FROM invoice_deviations
  GROUP BY Country
)
SELECT 
  id.InvoiceId,
  id.Country,
  id.invoice_avg_price,
  id.deviation,
  id.deviation - cad.country_avg_deviation as excess_deviation
FROM invoice_deviations id
LEFT JOIN country_avg_deviations cad ON id.Country = cad.Country
ORDER BY excess_deviation DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
